core_problem_solved: To provide a complete, conformant, and high-performance implementation of modern XML processing standards, including XSLT 2.0/3.0, XQuery 3.0/3.1, and XPath 2.0/3.1, which are far more powerful than the legacy versions included in the standard JDK.
key_features: A leading XSLT 3.0 and XQuery 3.1 processor
A high-performance XPath engine supporting modern standards
Availability in open-source (Home Edition) and commercial editions
era_and_niche: The industry-standard, state-of-the-art processor for advanced XML transformations and querying in the Java (and .NET) ecosystems. It is essential for any project that needs to go beyond the capabilities of the built-in JAXP.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**; it is a modern, actively maintained, and leading product. It is the **modern functional replacement** for older XSLT 1.0 processors like Apache Xalan, which was often the default in older Java environments.
